label: DELVE/DELVE DR2 (US-East, S3)
name: DELVE DR2
description: The DECam Local Volume Exploration Survey Data Release 2 (DELVE DR2) combines new DECam observations with archival DECam data from the Dark Energy Survey, the DECam Legacy Survey, and other DECam community programs to study dwarf satellite galaxies over a wide range of luminosities and environments. It consists of ~160,000 exposures that cover >21,000 deg^2 of the high Galactic latitude (|b| > 10 deg) sky in four broadband optical/near-infrared filters (g, r, i, z), with point-source and automatic aperture photometry for ~2.5 billion astronomical sources.
